# Translation guidance

Translate the documentation into natural, technical Vietnamese aimed at
engineers who maintain this repository daily.

## Voice and tone

- Address the reader as "bạn"; keep instructions direct and practical.
- Prefer the plainest Vietnamese phrasing that stays technically precise; a
  sentence that reads smoothly beats one that sounds formal.
- Keep paragraphs short, matching the source's rhythm.

## Terms

- Terms in the configured glossary stay exactly as written — they are
  product or protocol names.
- When no established Vietnamese term exists for an English technical word,
  keep the English word; do not invent translations.
- Code identifiers, file paths, CLI flags and configuration keys are never
  translated.

## Structure

- Keep every heading level, list marker, badge image and fence exactly
  where the source has it.
- Translate prose only: code blocks, inline code, badges and link
  destinations arrive finalised and must not change.
